This '''compound''' on the alps above the mining town of [[Jenith]] on [[Chelloa]] was the residence of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]], ruler of the independent [[Daimanate]] princedom. While the Chelloan people toiled in hardship, he lived a secluded life of luxury. The compound was decorated with statues of Daiman engaged in various poses. It was [[Duel on Chelloa|raided]] [[Second Raid on Daiman's compound|twice]] by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
